limitations: The primary and independent demonstrations each use one key; no broad empirical success probability is claimed.
The successful 641- and 650-query counts are not claimed to be minimal.
Only revision 4 of four reported public PDF revisions was recovered for bytewise inspection.
The pinned source commit predates the final PDF by about 19 hours 47 minutes, and the paper does not name a source commit.

The executable result uses the source's contiguous row allocation. Complete recovery also follows under the cited four-row layout, but no separate paper-faithful implementation of the under-specified literal stripe map was executed.

Primary isolation was source and path based rather than a kernel sandbox; the independent reproduction added a scrubbed environment and unreadable private-seed directory, but no mount namespace or syscall trace.
The bounded public-history search cannot exclude private, removed, unpublished, or unindexed work, and search indexes can lag.
